- **Surfaces (`#0f172a` & `#1e293b`)**: Multi-tiered technical glass layers with distinct contrast ratios for panels, floating docks, virtualized tables, and interactive card modules.

## Brand & Style

This design system is tailored for mission-critical smart hardware and firmware localization environments, specifically for smart bike computers, sensors, and telemetry instruments. The design ethos balances high-density technical utility with modern performance styling.

The visual style blends **Modern Technical Glassmorphism** with **Cyber-Instrument Density**:
- **Obsidian Dark Foundation**: Deep slate base tones reduce optical fatigue during intensive translation and code audit sessions.
- **Glassmorphic Precision**: Elevated surfaces incorporate translucent layering with subtle inner highlights and structural borders, evoking calibrated cockpit displays and avionics interfaces.
- **High-Velocity Accents**: High-energy Magene Orange commands primary interactions and active states, while Aurora Cyan anchors automated intelligence, vector translation memory matches, and telemetry metrics.
- **Engineered Ergonomics**: High information density tailored for firmware engineers, technical translators, and product managers. Interfaces prioritize strict character boundaries, pixel-grid typography, and hardware LCD/OLED constraints.

## Layout & Spacing

This design system employs an engineered fluid workspace layout built for large-screen density and multi-pane firmware tooling:

- **Base Rhythm**: Built on a strict 4px sub-grid, scaling predictably through `space-xs` (4px), `space-sm` (8px), `space-md` (16px), `space-lg` (24px), and `space-xl` (32px).
- **Master-Detail 3-Pane Structure**:
  - **Left Rail & Category Tree** (`300px` fixed): Navigational hierarchy containing firmware sensor categories, power meter menus, and module trees.
  - **Center Virtual Table** (`380px` – `440px` adaptive): High-density translation string catalog with real-time hardware status indicators and search filters.
  - **Right Hardware & Copilot Workspace** (`flex-1`, min `640px`): Deep translation editor featuring live 2.4" LCD matrix simulation, hardware boundary meters, and multi-model AI reasoning panels.
- **Form-Factor Adaptations**:
  - **Desktop (≥1440px)**: Full simultaneous 3-pane workflow with persistent sidebar and secondary telemetry drawer.
  - **Tablet / Laptop (1024px – 1439px)**: The left pane collapses into a slide-out drawer or icon strip (64px), dedicating maximum horizontal real estate to the string table and editor.
  - **Compact (<1024px)**: Transition into single-focus stacked tabs (Catalog view vs. Focused Translation View) with pinned mobile actions.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual depth is achieved through **glassmorphic surface layering and low-contrast perimeter highlights**, rejecting heavy drop shadows in favor of crisp technical layering:

- **Level 0 (Canvas Base)**: `#020617` solid obsidian floor. Zero blur.
- **Level 1 (Structural Paneling)**: `#0f172a` rendered with `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` and a continuous 1px outline of `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)`. Used for navigation trees, tables, and detail containers.
- **Level 2 (Interactive Floating Surfaces)**: `#1e293b` with a fine border of `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)` and an ambient shadow: `0 8px 32px -4px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.7)`. Used for modals, floating action bars, tooltips, and command palette (`Cmd+K`).
- **Level 3 (Focus & Active Emittance)**: Elements with active focus or selection state emit a 1px inner border and a restrained outer glow using the primary accent (`rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.25)`) or AI secondary accent (`rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.25)`).

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary**: Solid Magene Orange (`#f97316`) background with pure dark `#020617` bold typography. Hover introduces subtle brightness enhancement. Active state compresses scale to `0.98`.
- **Secondary / Ghost**: Translucent `#1e293b` background with 1px border (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)`), transitioning to Aurora Cyan borders upon interaction.
- **AI Action**: Aurora Cyan (`#06b6d4`) semi-transparent fill (`rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15)`) with a crisp `#06b6d4` stroke and glowing text.

### Chips & Status Badges
- **Diff Indicators**: Compact badges using `mono-metric` typography. `ADD` utilizes emerald tints (`#10b981`), `MOD` utilizes amber (`#f59e0b`), and `DEL` utilizes red (`#f43f5e`).
- **Memory & Match Chips**: Pill-shaped with subtle glass background and color-coded dot indicator for translation memory precision.

### Input Fields & Translation Cells
- **Text Inputs**: Built over `#0f172a` glass with a 1px border (`#1e293b`). Focusing shifts the border instantly to `#f97316` with a faint orange radial outline.
- **Source vs. Target Boxes**: Source strings are read-only with a muted slate boundary. Target edit zones feature monospaced cursor tracking and real-time glyph validation.

### Hardware Constraint Meter
- An integrated hardware telemetry progress bar placed beneath active translation inputs.
- Displays string length in real time against firmware LCD limits. Shifts color dynamically: `#10b981` (<70%), `#f59e0b` (70–99%), and flashing `#f43f5e` (≥100% or illegal line break).

### Cards & LCD Simulation Dock
- **Panels**: `#0f172a` glass card with top-edge specular highlight (`1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`).
- **Virtual LCD Matrix**: High-contrast inner bezel featuring simulated monochrome dot-matrix or OLED subpixel rendering to visualize hardware clipping in real-time.

## Brand & Style

This design system is tailored for mission-critical smart hardware and firmware localization environments, specifically for smart bike computers, sensors, and telemetry instruments. The design ethos balances high-density technical utility with modern performance styling.

The visual style blends **Modern Technical Glassmorphism** with **Cyber-Instrument Density**:
- **Obsidian Dark Foundation**: Deep slate base tones reduce optical fatigue during intensive translation and code audit sessions.
- **Glassmorphic Precision**: Elevated surfaces incorporate translucent layering with subtle inner highlights and structural borders, evoking calibrated cockpit displays and avionics interfaces.
- **High-Velocity Accents**: High-energy Magene Orange commands primary interactions and active states, while Aurora Cyan anchors automated intelligence, vector translation memory matches, and telemetry metrics.
- **Engineered Ergonomics**: High information density tailored for firmware engineers, technical translators, and product managers. Interfaces prioritize strict character boundaries, pixel-grid typography, and hardware LCD/OLED constraints.

## Colors

The palette operates in a native dark environment designed around precision, visual hierarchy, and instant hardware status recognition:

- **Primary (`#f97316`)**: Magene Orange drives the main call-to-action pathways, active focused cells, selection indicators, and primary commit buttons.
- **Secondary (`#06b6d4`)**: Aurora Cyan designates machine intelligence, vector memory matches, algorithmic suggestions, and dynamic copilot interactions.
- **Neutral Canvas (`#020617`)**: Deep obsidian base canvas serving as the ultimate zero-layer backdrop for all layout containers.
- **Surfaces (`#0f172a` & `#1e293b`)**: Multi-tiered technical glass layers with distinct contrast ratios for panels, floating docks, virtualized tables, and interactive card modules.
- **Semantic Accents**:
  - `status-success` (`#10b981`): Verified strings, 100% translation memory matches, and safe character budgets (<70%).
  - `status-warning` (`#f59e0b`): Nearing memory or character envelope thresholds (70%–95%), modified diff tags, and review flags.
  - `status-danger` (`#f43f5e`): Hardware LCD/OLED string overflow, format placeholder mismatches (`%s`, `%d`), and deletion statuses.

## Typography

The typographic hierarchy implements a dual-typeface structure tailored for dense software localization and hardware verification:

- **Inter**: Handles all global structural typography, interface titles, form controls, and body text. Its neutral neo-grotesque geometry ensures legibility at small sizes and high scanning speeds across complex data grids.
- **JetBrains Mono**: Dedicated to technical entities, including firmware macro keys (`KEY_RIDE_PWR_CALIB`), binary memory offsets, character length counters (`14/18 char`), format placeholders, and translation memory match scores.

Letter spacing is tightened slightly across large headings to convey industrial precision, while monospaced labels carry positive tracking to prevent visual clumping in condensed table cells.

## Layout & Spacing

This design system employs an engineered fluid workspace layout built for large-screen density and multi-pane firmware tooling:

- **Base Rhythm**: Built on a strict 4px sub-grid, scaling predictably through `space-xs` (4px), `space-sm` (8px), `space-md` (16px), `space-lg` (24px), and `space-xl` (32px).
- **Master-Detail 3-Pane Structure**:
  - **Left Rail & Category Tree** (`300px` fixed): Navigational hierarchy containing firmware sensor categories, power meter menus, and module trees.
  - **Center Virtual Table** (`380px` – `440px` adaptive): High-density translation string catalog with real-time hardware status indicators and search filters.
  - **Right Hardware & Copilot Workspace** (`flex-1`, min `640px`): Deep translation editor featuring live 2.4" LCD matrix simulation, hardware boundary meters, and multi-model AI reasoning panels.
- **Form-Factor Adaptations**:
  - **Desktop (≥1440px)**: Full simultaneous 3-pane workflow with persistent sidebar and secondary telemetry drawer.
  - **Tablet / Laptop (1024px – 1439px)**: The left pane collapses into a slide-out drawer or icon strip (64px), dedicating maximum horizontal real estate to the string table and editor.
  - **Compact (<1024px)**: Transition into single-focus stacked tabs (Catalog view vs. Focused Translation View) with pinned mobile actions.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual depth is achieved through **glassmorphic surface layering and low-contrast perimeter highlights**, rejecting heavy drop shadows in favor of crisp technical layering:

- **Level 0 (Canvas Base)**: `#020617` solid obsidian floor. Zero blur.
- **Level 1 (Structural Paneling)**: `#0f172a` rendered with `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` and a continuous 1px outline of `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)`. Used for navigation trees, tables, and detail containers.
- **Level 2 (Interactive Floating Surfaces)**: `#1e293b` with a fine border of `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)` and an ambient shadow: `0 8px 32px -4px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.7)`. Used for modals, floating action bars, tooltips, and command palette (`Cmd+K`).
- **Level 3 (Focus & Active Emittance)**: Elements with active focus or selection state emit a 1px inner border and a restrained outer glow using the primary accent (`rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.25)`) or AI secondary accent (`rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.25)`).

## Shapes

The design uses **Soft (Level 1)** geometric curves. Radii are intentionally disciplined to maintain a calibrated instrument aesthetic:

- **Base Radii (`rounded-sm` / 4px)**: Micro badges, character meters, table cell tags, and diff indicators.
- **Standard Controls (`DEFAULT` / 6px to `rounded-md` / 8px)**: Input fields, buttons, monospaced code blocks, and dropdown menus.
- **Containers (`rounded-lg` / 12px)**: Editor cards, preview monitors, and copilot accordions.
- **Pill Tags (`rounded-full`)**: Exclusive to status tags (`TM 100%`, `ADD`, `MOD`, `DEL`) and telemetry pills.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary**: Solid Magene Orange (`#f97316`) background with pure dark `#020617` bold typography. Hover introduces subtle brightness enhancement. Active state compresses scale to `0.98`.
- **Secondary / Ghost**: Translucent `#1e293b` background with 1px border (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)`), transitioning to Aurora Cyan borders upon interaction.
- **AI Action**: Aurora Cyan (`#06b6d4`) semi-transparent fill (`rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15)`) with a crisp `#06b6d4` stroke and glowing text.

### Chips & Status Badges
- **Diff Indicators**: Compact badges using `mono-metric` typography. `ADD` utilizes emerald tints (`#10b981`), `MOD` utilizes amber (`#f59e0b`), and `DEL` utilizes red (`#f43f5e`).
- **Memory & Match Chips**: Pill-shaped with subtle glass background and color-coded dot indicator for translation memory precision.

### Input Fields & Translation Cells
- **Text Inputs**: Built over `#0f172a` glass with a 1px border (`#1e293b`). Focusing shifts the border instantly to `#f97316` with a faint orange radial outline.
- **Source vs. Target Boxes**: Source strings are read-only with a muted slate boundary. Target edit zones feature monospaced cursor tracking and real-time glyph validation.

### Hardware Constraint Meter
- An integrated hardware telemetry progress bar placed beneath active translation inputs.
- Displays string length in real time against firmware LCD limits. Shifts color dynamically: `#10b981` (<70%), `#f59e0b` (70–99%), and flashing `#f43f5e` (≥100% or illegal line break).

### Cards & LCD Simulation Dock
- **Panels**: `#0f172a` glass card with top-edge specular highlight (`1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`).
- **Virtual LCD Matrix**: High-contrast inner bezel featuring simulated monochrome dot-matrix or OLED subpixel rendering to visualize hardware clipping in real-time.
